beginner.title: Get started with Balance meditation
beginner.outcome: You can: set up Balance meditation, find your way around and finish a first small task
beginner.practice: Complete the official getting-started guide, then one small real task from your work

beginner.title: Set up with privacy in mind
beginner.outcome: You can: set up Balance meditation and control your data

beginner.title: Daily habit
beginner.outcome: You can: use Balance meditation daily without effort
beginner.practice: Use Balance meditation daily for a week

intermediate.title: Read your trends
intermediate.outcome: You can: understand what the data says
intermediate.practice: Review a month of data and set one goal

intermediate.title: Share with a professional
intermediate.practice: Prepare a summary for a coach or clinician

intermediate.title: Signature skills in Balance meditation
intermediate.outcome: You can: use the features that make Balance meditation distinctive
intermediate.practice: Use each of these features once on a real piece of work

expert.title: Advanced Balance meditation
expert.outcome: You can: use Balance meditation's advanced capabilities with confidence
expert.practice: Complete a project that needs at least two of these advanced capabilities

expert.title: Coach others
expert.outcome: You can: use Balance meditation to support clients or family
expert.practice: Set up Balance meditation for a client or family member

expert.title: Integrate Balance meditation into your workflow
expert.outcome: You can: connect Balance meditation with the other tools you use
expert.practice: Connect Balance meditation to one other tool you use and remove one manual step

expert.title: Lead and teach others
expert.outcome: You can: set standards and teach others to use Balance meditation well
expert.practice: Write a one-page "how we use Balance meditation" guide and teach it to one person

expert_validation.note: Generated from the archetype template plus tool-specific signature skills; to be reviewed by a practitioner.
